description: This file contains utility functions and an implementation of a verification routine for checking the configuration and connectivity of a Supabase backend integration within a frontend environment. It performs checks on environment variables, authentication session, database access, and storage buckets, producing a structured report.

methods.name: nowIso()
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in ISO string format.

methods.name: safeErrorToObject(err)
methods.description: Converts an error object into a structured plain object capturing known fields.

methods.name: createCheck({ id, label, severity, ok, detail, meta })
methods.description: Creates a structured check object with properties like id, label, severity, ok, detail, and meta.

methods.name: summarize(checks)
methods.description: Summarizes an array of check objects into overall status, counts of errors and warnings.

methods.name: runSupabaseVerification()
methods.description: Main exported asynchronous function that performs a series of health checks on the Supabase setup and returns a detailed report.

ctags.name: createCheck
ctags.pattern: /^function createCheck({ id, label, severity, ok, detail, meta }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ id, label, severity, ok, detail, meta })
